sub.en: Asking for directions, directional words (left, right, straight), and public transit
sub.ko: 길 묻기 표현, 방향 어휘(왼쪽, 오른쪽, 곧장), 대중교통 이용하기

desc.en: Free printable Korean worksheet on directions and transportation: asking where things are (어디예요?), directional words (왼쪽, 오른쪽, 직진), taking subways and buses (타다, 내리다, 갈아타다) with practice exercises and an answer key.

sections.note: The direction particle (으)로 indicates destination or direction: 왼쪽으로 (leftward), 오른쪽으로 (rightward), 앞으로 (forward).

rows: Polite opening before asking a stranger
Asking for the route or transit method
sections.note: Standard pattern: [Place]이/가 어디예요? (Where is [place]?) or [Place]에 어떻게 가요? (How do I get to [place]?)
Particles: [Vehicle]을/를 타다 (ride vehicle), [Vehicle]에서 내리다 (get off vehicle), [Vehicle](으)로 갈아타다 (transfer to vehicle).

title.en: Practice A — Write the direction phrase in Korean
Practice B — Write the transportation vehicle in Korean
Practice C — Complete the direction question and answer

items.q: Excuse me, where is the station? (실례합니다, 지하철역이 ___ ?) →
Please go to the right (오른쪽___ 가세요) →

title.en: Practice D — Choose the fitting transit verb

items.q: 버스를 ___ (타요 / 내려요) — I get on the bus →
지하철에서 ___ (내려요 / 타요) — I get off the subway →
학교까지 ___ 가요 (걸어서 / 내려서) — I go on foot →

howto: Learn how to ask for locations using [Place]이/가 어디예요? and [Place]에 어떻게 가요?.
Practice direction particles: 왼쪽으로 (to the left), 오른쪽으로 (to the right), 앞으로 (straight ahead).
Master the core transit verbs: 타다 (ride), 내리다 (get off), 갈아타다 (transfer) in Practice A–D.
koSummary: 길 묻기 필수 표현(실례합니다, 어디예요?, 어떻게 가요?), 방향 어휘(왼쪽, 오른쪽, 곧장), 주요 대중교통과 동작 동사(타다, 내리다, 갈아타다)를 한 장에 정리했습니다. 문제를 풀고 정답지로 확인하세요.
